request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: For positive integers A, B, C, x, y, z with A^x + B^y = C^z and x, y, z >= 3, then gcd(A, B, C) > 1. Strictly requires x,y,z >= 3 (strictly hyperbolic defect 1/x + 1/y + 1/z - 1 <= -1/12). Primitive solutions (gcd(A,B,C)=1) must be non-existent.
request_state.title: Serre Level Wild Conductor Invariant N(rho_{E, p}) at Primes 2 and 3
request_state.description: Calculates the minimal conductor of the Frey curve representation. Detects coprimality gcd(A, B, C) = 1 via additive reduction exponents at 2 and 3.

fc_defect_discrimination.instructions: Does this candidate mathematical invariant distinguish the 10 known Fermat-Catalan identities (1^m + 2^3 = 3^2, 2^5 + 7^2 = 3^4, 7^3 + 13^2 = 2^9...) with exponent 2 from genuine Beal configurations (x,y,z >= 3)? Specifically, does it exploit the strict hyperbolic defect 1 - 1/x - 1/y - 1/z >= 1/12 such that it vanishes or is blocked on exponent 2?

criteria.true: Strictly distinguishes exponent 2 from Beal; exploits the hyperbolic defect -chi >= 1/12.
criteria.false: Fermat-Catalan blind: holds equally on exponent 2 identities.

coprimality_coupling.instructions: Does the invariant couple directly to the coprimality condition gcd(A, B, C) = 1 (e.g. through tame/wild conductor, Serre level, or discriminant valuation), distinguishing coprime integer points from projectively scaled multiples?

criteria.true: Directly couples to coprimality; sensitive to common factors.
criteria.false: Projectively invariant; insensitive to integer gcd scaling.

finiteness_or_vanishing.instructions: What is the ultimate Diophantine consequence forced by this invariant?

criteria.nonexistence_certificate: Forces complete non-existence of primitive solutions when x, y, z >= 3.
criteria.finiteness_only: Proves finiteness of solutions (Faltings/Chabauty), leaving unknown points uneliminated.
criteria.local_obstruction: Provides local obstructions modulo specific prime powers.
criteria.vacuous: Does not constrain integer coordinates on the hypersurface.

breakthrough_score.instructions: Evaluate the breakthrough potential of this invariant toward an unconditional resolution of Beal's conjecture.
criteria: level 0: Blind or vacuous; provides no leverage.
level 1: Minor local constraint; does not close any signature.
level 2: Strong structural invariant; closes an infinite signature family or settles bounded prime range.
level 3: Unconditional resolution; overcomes both the exponent 2 defect and the coprimality obstacle.
